Supported enterprise deployments serving up to 50,000 employees.

Led internal sessions to help engineers automate day-to-day development tasks using LLMs.

Developed a Reward Marketplace with redemption workflows, voucher lifecycle management, and third-party vendor integrations.

Increased portal engagement by approximately 40% by building Slack-based workflows powered by webhooks and event-driven backend integrations.
Mentored engineers in a 3-person team by guiding implementation, reviewing contributions, and driving delivery across mobile and backend initiatives.
Built an internal SDK to streamline communication with CRM services.
Improved integration consistency across backend workflows.
Developed cron-based automation, queue-driven processing, and cache-backed services to improve reliability and efficiency of scheduled backend operations.
